story: Why: she is getting ready to go out and wears her perfume. Cap off, one spray on the wrist, set it down.
storyboard_prompt: Image 1 is the product photo: use exactly this product, its shape, materials, colours and logos. Create ONE storyboard image made of a 2x2 grid of four equal photo panels, edge to edge, with no borders, no gaps, no text and no numbers. Shot on a 35mm film camera, Kodak Portra 400, visible film grain, slight halation around highlights, natural unretouched colours, a real photograph, not a render. Every panel: First-person view at her eye level looking down about 30 degrees at a worn light oak table by a window, 35mm lens, no zoom, no cuts. Handheld: the frame drifts and bobs slightly with her breathing, focus breathes and lands a moment late. Low warm window daylight from the left, one side of everything lit, soft real shadows falling to the right. Lived-in table: a coffee ring, a few crumbs and a folded receipt, framing slightly off-centre. Only her hands and forearms are visible, no face. Only the same young woman's hands and forearms: real skin with fine pores, knuckle creases, a faint vein on the back of the hand, slightly dry fingertips, short soft-pink nails with a tiny chip. Exactly two hands, exactly one bottle and exactly one black cap in each panel. The bottle: a thick rectangular clear glass perfume bottle with gently rounded corners, a heavy glass base, amber-golden liquid, plain clear glass with faint fingerprints, with a short matte black cylindrical cap. Panel 1 (top left): her RIGHT hand holds the bottle upright at the centre, the black cap on top; her LEFT hand rests flat on the table on the left. Panel 2 (top right): the cap is off and lies on its side on the table on the LEFT; the top of the bottle shows a short polished silver metal crimp collar and a small round silver push-button spray head; her RIGHT hand still holds the WHOLE bottle upright at the centre. Panel 3 (bottom left): her LEFT forearm lies on the table in the lower left, the inside of the wrist turned up; her RIGHT hand holds the WHOLE bottle a little to the right of that wrist, the index finger on the silver spray head; a fine short cone of mist goes from the spray head onto the wrist; the black cap still lies on its side on the LEFT. Panel 4 (bottom right): the bottle stands upright on the table at the centre right, its silver spray head uncovered, the light glowing through the amber liquid and throwing an amber patch on the wood; the black cap still lies on the LEFT; both hands rest on the table. The same camera position, table, light and hands in all four panels; the bottle about the height of her palm. Candid, unretouched photographs with natural imperfections: real dust, fingerprints, uneven light, slight lens vignetting. No extra products, no added text, no watermark.
